ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: I picked Petrel-235B because the survey-design request is a straightforward, neutral transactional task with no sensitive or harm-adjacent content. Petrel-235B scores meaningfully higher than Avocet-235B across the relevant capability dimensions — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8), Summarization (86.4 vs 80.3), IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6), and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4) — all of which matter for producing a clean, well-organized, instruction-following deliverable. The user also explicitly asked for something simple and correct, which favors the stronger instruction-following model. Petrel also marginally prefers neutral transactional requests (50 vs 49), so there's no preference-based reason to route elsewhere.
